exposure: pre-eclampsia (PE) status (normotensive, PE without severe features, PE with severe features)
cohort: The study included 30 normotensive pregnant women as controls and 50 pregnant women with pre-eclampsia as cases.
finding: The study found a significant association between altered coagulation profiles (lower platelet count, higher MPV/PDW, prolonged APTT/TT, and decreased serum fibrinogen) and the severity of pre-eclampsia in late pregnancy.
cross-section timing: Mid-pregnancy (24 to 27 weeks) and late pregnancy (37 to 40 weeks) or at the time of admission for delivery.
